name: AHEESA DIGITAL INNOVATIONS PRIVATE LIMITED
india_angle: Aheesa Digital Innovations is focused on indigenous silicon design in India, supported by the MeitY Design-Linked Incentive scheme.
summary: Aheesa Digital Innovations Private Limited is a fabless semiconductor design house in India, specializing in RISC-V networking SoC platforms. Their products are aimed at reducing dependence on imported telecom silicon and strengthening national technology capabilities.
